iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 4 scan: Reuters May 2 reports Iran offered to reopen Hormuz/end the war while deferring nuclear talks, and Trump rejected terms he said he could not accept. That leaves the nuclear dispute unresolved behind a live conventional crisis. No confirmed 90% enrichment or nuclear test; risk remains driven by unresolved IAEA/access/60% stockpile uncertainty and diplomacy sequencing failure. Probability 58%. Stable/imminent.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: May 4 scan: Reuters May 2 says Trump rejected an Iranian proposal that would open the Strait of Hormuz, end Iran's blockade of Gulf shipping, and end the war before later nuclear talks. Reuters describes the conflict as the biggest disruption ever to global energy supplies. No confirmed new strike package, but the chokepoint crisis remains unresolved. Probability 78%. Rising/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 4 scan: Al Jazeera May 2 reports Israeli drones and warplanes killed at least 10 in southern Lebanon despite the April 17 ceasefire, 44 killed over two days, Hezbollah pledging continued attacks, and Israeli officers signalling readiness to broaden the conflict. Ceasefire is nominal, not durable. Probability 80%. Rising/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: May 4 scan: no fresh Turkey kinetic trigger surfaced. Reuters search still shows Turkey acting mainly through NATO/Ukraine diplomacy and older Iran-missile air-defense spillover. Turkey-Israel/Syria grey-zone risk persists, but immediate nuclear-escalation relevance is secondary. Probability 30%. Stable/critical.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: May 4 scan: no reliable fresh India-Pakistan escalation item found; Reuters results are dominated by stale 2025 conflict material and generic 2026 warnings. No new mobilization, missile exchange, or official nuclear rhetoric detected. Probability 8%. Falling/deterrent.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: May 4 scan: no new Russian nuclear alert change detected. Reuters Apr 23 remains the key active signal: Moscow warned European states hosting French nuclear-capable bombers would become priority targets. Background Russia-NATO nuclear rhetoric remains elevated, but the fresh May signal set is mostly Ukraine-war kinetic rather than direct NATO nuclear escalation. Probability 38%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China
china.notes: May 4 scan: China-Taiwan remains high operational tempo but no confirmed invasion trigger. Search surfaced Reuters context that Taiwan risks normalization of daily PLA military activity; prior Taiwan MND reporting showed heavy aircraft/naval presence and median-line/ADIZ crossings. Balikatan/allied activity sustains coupling risk. Probability 66%. Stable/imminent.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 4 scan: no new launch after the Apr 18-19 cluster-warhead ballistic missile tests. Reuters says those tests were North Korea's seventh ballistic missile launch of 2026 and fourth in April, with IAEA-linked concerns over rapid nuclear advances/new enrichment capacity. Lack of fresh launch nudges risk below imminent threshold. Probability 48%. Falling/critical.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 4 scan: Reuters/BBC report a major May 3-4 strike cycle: Ukraine hit Russia's Primorsk oil terminal, ships/tankers and Perm oil infrastructure; Russia launched one ballistic missile and nearly 270 drones, killing 10 and injuring at least 76 across Ukraine. Putin's narrow Victory Day ceasefire proposal is insufficient to offset the widening deep-strike pattern. Probability 55%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 4 scan: no fresh May border-clash report surfaced. Reuters/Al Jazeera results continue to point to late-February/March Pakistan-Afghanistan hostilities and cross-border strikes; the absence of new confirmed kinetic escalation lowers near-term risk but leaves border conflict elevated. Probability 20%. Falling/elevated.
